annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires matching IP addresses and UDP ports per RFC8085, and additionally requires matching connection IDs to an active QUIC session when such IDs are available. The phrase “when possible” clearly indicates that the connection‑ID check is optional if the ICMP message does not contain a connection ID or if no active session can be found. No other interpretation or missing constraint is suggested by the supplied text.
